'''Siriki''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She made her living as a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] on board [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Siriki first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as an [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] planetary commendation vendor on board Carrick Station.
